reviewer_provenance: Author A completed and sealed its own draft before opening author B annotations, audit or seal. This review evaluates B; it does not independently accept A's own draft and does not claim human review.
scope: All 12 original title/abstract sources, every supplied evidence sentence, all five facets; B annotations/audit/seal read. No full567 rollout, old targets, student outputs or project test content accessed.

material_issues.policy_basis: Policy 1 task role and policy 5 scan for missing main tasks.
material_issues.finding: The abstract's show-that activities establish OWL-Full inference undecidability and decidability under proposed alternatives. These are formal proof objectives, not prediction tasks or an act of merely proposing a method.

items.concept: show that the semantics of metamodeling adopted in OWL-Full leads to undecidability of basic inference problems
the contextual and the HiLog semantics: show that SHOIQ- a description logic underlying OWL-DL- extended with metamodeling under either semantics is decidable.

method.rationale: The two proposed semantics are independent current artifacts/methods. OWL-Full/OWL-DL/SHOIQ are analyzed formalisms rather than automatically additional methods.

dataset.rationale: Ontology languages and a description logic do not establish a named structured data resource.

contribution.rationale: Both semantics and all three findings are retained. The undecidability cause, both alternatives for 'either', and HiLog antecedent of 'latter' are explicit. The practical capability is not misreported as field deployment.

problem.rationale: The shared-gene limitation retains can, variable combinations, and especially complex diseases.

A5's two introduced functions are current methods; exact GO matches and gene overlap in A8 are baseline-only validation comparators and are correctly excluded. Co-occurrence/information-content bases are already preserved inside each compound function.

dataset.rationale: Gene Ontology is explicitly named and used. Its full source name is safe given the potentially ambiguous bare GO; no external alias is invented. The other datasets remain unnamed.

contribution.rationale: Two source-distinguished function levels are valid artifact units. The complete numeric comparison, external-set Pearson correlation, and regulation finding preserve subjects, values, comparators and scope. Omitting A6's generic outperformance claim is reasonable because A8 gives the informative comparison without inventing the generic comparator.

entries.focus_resolution: Prefer B over A for the baseline-only and function-task questions. A's extra comparator methods and term/entity tasks should not be adopted. This is a role correction resolvable by policy 1, not unresolved policy ambiguity.

material_issues.finding: Evidence IDs A3/A4 are correct, but they do not repair a concept whose own subject is only 'consistent but modest improvements in system performance'.
material_issues.resolution: Merge the two related performance/cause items into a connected finding with the full A3 subject and temporal scope. Current policy already governs this correction.

items.concept: Our survey demonstrates that to date, the use of information in existing typological databases has resulted in consistent but modest improvements in system performance. We show that this is due to both intrinsic limitations of databases (in terms of coverage and feature granularity) and under-utilization of the typological features included in them.

items.concept: on word order task: Our results show that the quality of automatically-parsed training data has a relatively small impact on syntactic models.
on word order task: Both of syntactic and N-gram models can benefit from large-scale raw text.
on word order task: Compared with N-gram models, syntactic models give overall better performance, but they require much more training time.
N-gram and syntactic language models on word order task: A combination of the two models integrates the advantages of each model, achieving the best result in a standard benchmark.

summary.rollout_disposition: Resolve these ordinary annotation corrections in a new adjudicated artifact and independently review that result before rollout. No policy change is required by this review.
summary.own_draft_limitations: This cross-review does not certify A. In particular, A's P001951 comparator methods and function-task additions should not be adopted; A's P003896 finding-scope omissions need the same correction.
key_role_resolutions: P001951 is new-method validation; comparator baselines are excluded, unlike a comparison-as-primary-objective study.
P000054 already has an integrated retrieval/simulation decision workflow, so no mandatory redundant hybrid-parent item.
P002222 formal analysis is primary work and is omitted from B's task facet.
Survey methods, unnamed-resource exclusions, modal demonstrations, all quantitative comparator values and negative findings are otherwise supported.
